entities.name: Northern Paladin
entities.description: One of the four paladins of the ballad, who values swords and virtue over trinkets.

entities.name: Southern Paladin
entities.description: A paladin who speaks of staying alive and the duty of the strong to protect the weak.

entities.name: Eastern Paladin
entities.description: A paladin with a passion for death who attacks at night and rings his city with a wall of bone.

entities.name: Western Paladin
entities.description: A greedy and cruel paladin who commands fiercely loyal serpent warriors.

entities.name: Lord of Atlantis
entities.description: A master of tactics who leads the merfolk.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: An angel-making figure to whom a fallen angel speaks.

entities.name: Maro
entities.description: A forest entity that no two see the same.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: Author of the Necromancer's Handbook.

entities.name: Toren
entities.description: A man embarrassed when a bug stepped on him.

entities.name: Numsgil
entities.description: A goblin who became king by doing in Blog.

entities.name: Blog
entities.description: A goblin king done in by Numsgil.

entities.name: Unkful
entities.description: A goblin king done in by Blog.

entities.name: Viddle
entities.description: A goblin king done in by Unkful.

entities.name: Loll
entities.description: A goblin king done in by Viddle.

entities.name: Alrok
entities.description: A goblin done in by Loll.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A departed figure whose final gift to his people is the Ban.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: A practical captain who likes pretty things only if useful.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian whose existence centers on warping bodies and souls.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The figure from whom the world and its elves grew.

entities.name: Aladdin
entities.description: A figure whose third wish was said to be for a ring.

entities.name: Elvish Champion
entities.description: An elvish champion who praises Gaea's forging.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A figure associated with wisdom.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A forest covering a million square miles.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A land of mountains ruled by the Shivan dragon.

entities.name: Atlantis
entities.description: The realm of the Lord of Atlantis.

entities.name: Pearl Trident
entities.description: Merfolk warriors who have turned the tide of human wars.

entities.name: Ghitu
entities.description: A people who believe their race was born of fire.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Home of Tolarian wizards.

events.summary: The Eastern Paladin prepares caltrops as a welcome for his rival, the Southern Paladin.
events.quote: The Eastern Paladin knew how highly his southern rival valued horses

events.summary: The Western Paladin kills an advisor who imagined enough gold.
events.quote: "I have no need of fools who can imagine 'enough,'" he told the advisor's corpse.

events.summary: Numsgil becomes goblin king by killing Blog, who had killed his predecessors in turn.
events.quote: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok.

events.summary: Feroz leaves his people the right to be left alone as his final gift.
events.quote: Feroz is gone, but what remains is his final gift to his people: the right to be left alone.

events.summary: The Southern Paladin trains airborne vermin to fear the catapult.
events.quote: The Southern Paladin taught the airborne vermin to fear the storm that rains upward.

relations.quote: The Eastern Paladin knew how highly his southern rival valued horses
